children: China's foreign exchange reserves, the world's largest, fell more than expected in September, central bank data showed on Wednesday, as the dollar regained strength.
The reserves came in at $3.400 trillion last month, versus $3.438 trillion a month earlier and economists' forecast of $3.420 trillion in a Reuters poll.
strengthened 0.22% against the dollar, while the greenback rose 2.06% against a basket of major currencies
